blockers.detail: The repository has build logic and runtime commands but no production dedicated-server launcher; C:\Users\lollo\mineocclude-server is absent.
The default launcher profiles do not contain a Minecraft 1.16.5 Fabric profile, and no repository-bound production client launcher exists.
No production server.properties, level seed, world folder, gamerule receipt, time/weather receipt, or pack receipt is available.
The frozen expected lock says spawn-animals=false while the prior dev observation reports that the experiment sheep requires true.
The exact production game directories do not exist or are not identified, so installed mod versions and hashes cannot be bound.
The read-only markergeomstatus command is prepared and tested but has not run in a fresh production server process.
No fresh observegeometry receipts exist for layouts 01 through 06.
No production client has connected, so actual feet/eye position, yaw, and pitch are unobserved.
No fresh raw PNG from the production client is available for byte and dimension inspection.
The only local options.txt is not bound to a 1.16.5 production profile; its raw values are not accepted.
Assignment is forbidden until all runtime receipts are complete and hash-bound.
